title: OpenJDK fixed CVE-2026-114938 (Java4Shell) on 17 Nov. A malformed Base64 string can make the x86-64 decoder write past the end of an array.
content_md:
OpenJDK fixed CVE-2026-114938 (Java4Shell) on 17 Nov. A malformed Base64 string can make the x86-64 decoder write past the end of an array.
